summary: Embraer S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting that the Colombian Air Force (FAC) signed a contract to acquire two KC-390 Millennium multi-mission aircraft, including mission equipment, services, and an offset program. This is an ordinary product sale announcement by a foreign private issuer, not a special-situation corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review. No financial terms, share prices, or transaction mechanics were disclosed. The filing is routine operational news, so it does not qualify for any special-situations category.
